record.question: What is the main indication for iron supplementation?
record.explanation: Answer A: Anaemia. Iron supplementation is indicated to prevent or treat iron deficiency, including iron-deficiency anemia when clinically appropriate. Source/context note: Not all anemia is due to iron deficiency; diagnose cause before supplementation. Reference: https://ods.od.nih.gov/factsheets/Iron-HealthProfessional/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
